L104: 【37†Show Champion】 Chart winners (2022)
L105: ---
L106: 【38†NCT Dream】's (pictured) win for "【39†Beatbox】" had the highest score of 2022, with 9,810 points at the June 8th broadcast.
L107: 
L108: The Show Champion Chart is a 【40†record chart】 on the South Korean 【41†MBC M】 【42†television music program】 【37†Show Champion】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【43†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.^{【44†[1]】}
L109: In 2022, 33 singles achieved number one on the chart, and 26 acts were awarded first-place trophies. "【39†Beatbox】" by 【38†NCT Dream】 had the highest score of the year, with 9,810 points on the June 8 broadcast. "【45†Shut Down】" by 【46†Blackpink】 is the only song to achieve a triple crown.
L110: ## Chart history
L111: 
L112: [【47†edit】]
L113: 
L114: 【48†Fromis 9】 (top), 【49†Le Sserafim】 (middle), and 【50†Loona】 (bottom) won Show Champion for the first time with their awards for "【51†DM】," "【52†Fearless】," and "【53†Flip That】," respectively.
L115: 【54†Viviz】 (top), 【55†Treasure】 (second from top), 【56†Dreamcatcher】 (third from top), 【57†Verivery】 (second from bottom), and 【58†Tempest】 (bottom) won their first ever music show trophies with their Show Champion awards for "【59†Bop Bop!】," "Jikjin," "Maison," "Tap Tap," and "Dragon," respectively.
